nvitk.morphology._common
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.morphology._common

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Internal helpers for the :mod:`nvitk.morphology` module.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.morphology._common._as_array
   nvitk.morphology._common._wrap_like

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: _as_array(obj: nvitk.types.Image | Any) -> Any

   Unwrap an :class:`Image` to its voxel array; pass raw arrays through.


.. py:function:: _wrap_like(original: nvitk.types.Image | Any, data: Any) -> nvitk.types.Image | Any

   Re-wrap *data* as an :class:`Image` when *original* was one; else return *data*.


.. py:function:: _coerce_to_current_backend(arr: Any) -> Any

   Move *arr* onto the currently-selected NumPy/CuPy backend.


.. py:function:: _iterate_structure_hostside(structure: Any, iterations: int) -> Any

   Run :func:`scipy.ndimage.iterate_structure` on NumPy then move back.


.. py:function:: make_ball_footprint(ndim: int, radius: int = 1, *, connectivity: int = 2) -> Any

   Return an ``ndi.generate_binary_structure``-based ball of *radius*.

   The result is on the current backend.


.. py:function:: _resolve_structure(ndim: int, footprint: int | Any | None, *, connectivity: int, isotropic: bool, spacing: Sequence[float] | None) -> Any

   Produce the final structuring element for morphology ops.
